payload.summary: Source-conflict and jurisdiction behaviour has no deliberate tests; owner to confirm the tier rule (audit F16)
payload.detail: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-25: confirmed the existing tier order (WA validated > Australian national > other Australian state > supplementary, within a relevance band) and asked for two additions: a superseded source is never used as evidence, and a clinically material WA-vs-national disagreement is disclosed with both sources shown. Found 2026-09-25: outdated sources are currently KEPT and shown with a danger-severity OUTDATED warning (src/lib/source-governance.ts), and authority conflict in source-authority-registry.ts means publisher-metadata mismatch, not clinical disagreement. Both additions change retrieval/answer behaviour: flag before editing and run a live canary pair (owner approval, about USD 1-2) around the change. A rule already exists: src/lib/australian-source-priority.ts ranks wa_validated < australian_national < australian_state < supplementary WITHIN a relevance band, and tracks authorityConflictCount. Only 3 eval cases touch conflict/superseded sources. Owner recommendation (2026-09-25): confirm that order, add (a) superseded versions never used as evidence and (b) disclose both sources when WA and national disagree on something clinically material. Next action: owner confirms the rule, then add conflict/currentness/attribution cases. Ranking is RAG-protected: flag before editing and require a canary pair for any ordering change.
